budget.title: Spending limits
budget.description: Hard USD ceilings. Unlike the routing budget under Providers, reaching one of these blocks the next request until you approve it.
budget.hardBlockHint: You are warned at {warn}% and {critical}%. At 100% the next request is held until you approve one more.
budget.perProviderDescription: Cap one provider without lowering the ceiling for everything else. Providers you spent on this month are listed automatically.
budget.perProviderEmpty: No per-provider limit yet. Add one to cap a single provider.
budget.thresholdsDescription: Percent of a limit at which you are notified. Leave blank to use the defaults.

debug.title: Trace debug session
debug.description: Captures streaming deltas, prompts and tool payloads locally so a problem can be reproduced. Expires on its own and never leaves this device.
debug.activeBadge: {minutes, plural, =0 {expiring} =1 {1 min left} other {# min left}}
debug.privacyHint: Captured content is excluded from backups, exports and diagnostic reports. Sessions default to {minutes} minutes.

spend.title: Spend against your limits
spend.description: Live totals from the same rollup the send gate reads, so this figure and the one that blocks a request are always the same.
spend.empty: Set a limit above and today's and this month's spend against it appear here.
